name: create_cluster
description:
Create a new cluster for Google Cloud Managed service for Apache Kafka.

This tool returns a long-running operation (LRO) that you can poll using the `get_operation` tool to track the cluster creation status. Cluster creation can take 30 minutes or longer.

**Important Notes:**

*   Do not create the cluster without getting all of the required parameters from the user.

caPools.description: Optional. A list of CA pools to pull CA certificates from.

clusterId.description: Required. The ID to use for the cluster, which will become the final component of the cluster's name.

kmsKey.description: Optional. The Cloud KMS Key name to use for encryption.

memoryBytes.description: Required. The memory to provision for the cluster in bytes. Minimum: 3 GiB.

parent.description: Required. The parent region in which to create the cluster. Format: projects/{project}/locations/{location}

rebalanceMode.description: Optional. The rebalance mode for the cluster. If not specified, AUTO_REBALANCE_ON_SCALE_UP will be used.
x-google-enum-descriptions: A mode was not specified. Do not use.
Automatically rebalance topic partitions among brokers when the cluster is scaled up.

sslPrincipalMappingRules.description: Optional. A list of rules for mapping from SSL principal names to short names.

subnets.description: Required. The VPC subnets for the cluster. Format: projects/{project}/regions/{region}/subnetworks/{subnet_id}

vcpuCount.description: Required. The number of vCPUs to provision for the cluster. Minimum: 3.
